name: Chana Dal Spinach
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) chana dal, soaked 1 hour
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Pressure-cook the chana dal with turmeric and 2 cups water for 4–5 whistles until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and spices and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook for 3 minutes. Stir in the dal and simmer for 8 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, lemon juice and salt.
note: Chana dal has a low glycaemic index and keeps its shape when cooked.
